svg.aria-label: P2 B: verified packet loss, completion, stop, traffic and conditional quality

g.text: B. Packet-loss robustness — batched Greedy Voting
100 robots · 100 tasks · capacity=1 · 100 paired seeds · 0–90% packet loss (step 10%)
Voting: 1,000 newly executed trials; CBAA / CBBA / Price Auction: 3,000 SHA-verified reused native trials
Concentric rings and dash styles show identical values without moving them.
Mean over all 100 seeds; native termination guarantees differ.
Decimal MB = 10⁶ bytes; lost sends included, not actual RF airtime.
Voting/CBAA n=100; other native-success cohorts vary; 80/90 undefined.
At PL=0, Voting equals full-information sequential Greedy for all 100 seeds; its Hungarian ratio is 1.351, not 1.0.
At PL=80/90, CBBA/Auction have no native-success samples; their quality is missing, not zero. Other quality series are successful-only.
Voting pays reliable Score/Commit; stops are not equivalent. Rady + assumed 144 Mbps is a simulation proxy, not measured Wi-Fi.
